_doc: Playbook §3.3a step 5 for the erasure -> redaction -> replay slice. 'stores' are the stored facts the invariants read; 'plans' are every product path that writes one of them (found by reading the code at 3eaa79cf and from the breadth modules' findings); 'invariants' list what each reads. tools/writesets.py computes every (invariant, plan) pair whose write set meets the read set and fails unless 'coverage' gives each pair a discharge: a proof or model check of the reviewed design, a live observation, a guard in the code, or a finding. A pair covered only by a finding is reported as open.

stores.meta: Graph_KG.ledger_revisions free text (message, source, correlation_id, idempotency_key)

INV-shape.rule: every record keeps its place; a record is its original or that original's tombstone (L1 shape_ok; RED-I1)

INV-isolation.rule: only records of a redacted target are tombstones (L1 tombs_ok, theorem_isolation; RED-I2)

INV-text.rule: a revision with a tombstone has no free text (L1 text_ok; RED-B3)

INV-retry.rule: no live retry key names a revision with a tombstone (L1 keys_ok; RED-B4)

INV-marker.rule: while the marker names t, no record of t is content and none is added (L1 marker_ok; RED-B5)

INV-no-live-tombstone.rule: a record becomes a tombstone only while its content is not live (theorem_begin_spares_live; RED-B1.1)

INV-stmt.rule: the live statement entries are exactly the live recorded edges (ERS-I2, ERS-I3)

INV-replay.rule: with no unrecorded writes and every erased target redacted, replay equals the store (RPL-B3)
